destep

destep is an R package for converting DeST building models to EnergyPlus. It helps reuse existing DeST models without rebuilding their inputs manually. Converted models can be inspected, edited, and simulated with eplusr.

Features

  • Convert building geometry, materials, constructions, windows, doors, and exterior shading.
  • Transfer schedules, internal heat and moisture gains, furniture heat storage, ventilation, and temperature and humidity controls.
  • Generate load-calculation models and selected physical HVAC configurations.
  • Convert DeST climate data to EnergyPlus EPW weather files.

destep is under active development. See ?to_eplus for supported model features, conversion options, and EnergyPlus version requirements, and NEWS for recent changes.

Installation

You can install the development version of destep like so:

install.packages("destep",
    repos = c(
        hongyuanjia = "https://hongyuanjia.r-universe.dev",
        cran = "https://cran.r-project.org"
    )
)

Get started 

library(destep)

# Download a DeST prototype model and load the target EnergyPlus dictionary
path <- download_dest_model("Commercial office A", "Chongqin", 2015, tempdir())
eplusr::use_idd("23.1", download = "auto")
# Convert the model and its weather data
dest <- read_dest(path)
idf <- to_eplus(dest, "23.1")
idf

epw <- to_epw(dest)
epw

DBI::dbDisconnect(dest)

# Save the EnergyPlus input and weather files
idf$save(file.path(tempdir(), "model.idf"))
epw$save(file.path(tempdir(), "weather.epw"))
